title: Finite-stage model of a quasi-compact open
statement: Fix the base-changed system of [def-nagata-basechanged-system] with $\lambda_0\in I$. Assume that $I$ is directed, $S=\varprojlim_\lambda S_\lambda$, every transition $S_\mu\to S_\lambda$ is affine, and $Y_{\lambda_0}$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated (as a scheme; this holds when $S_{\lambda_0}$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated and $Y_{\lambda_0}\to S_{\lambda_0}$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, e.g. $S_{\lambda_0}$ of finite type over $\mathbf Z$). Let $W\subseteq Y$ be a quasi-compact open. Choose a finite affine cover $Y_{\lambda_0}=\bigcup_{a=1}^m U_a$ and write $U_{a,\lambda}$ for its inverse image in $Y_\lambda$ and $U_a^\infty$ for its inverse image in $Y$. Since $Y\to Y_{\lambda_0}$ is affine and $Y_{\lambda_0}$ is quasi-separated, each $W\cap U_a^\infty$ is quasi-compact; choose a finite basic-open presentation $W\cap U_a^\infty=\bigcup_{k=1}^{r_a}D(f_{ak})$ with $f_{ak}\in\Gamma(U_a^\infty,\mathcal O)$. By [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition] and [lem-weil-pbc-limit-global-sections-colimit] (Tags 01YW/01Z0), $\Gamma(U_a^\infty,\mathcal O)\cong\varinjlim_{\lambda\geq\lambda_0}\Gamma(U_{a,\lambda},\mathcal O)$. For each $a$, apply [lemma-nagata-filtered-colimit-finite-data] to this directed system and the finitely many $f_{ak}$ (with no equalities) to obtain a stage $\lambda_a\geq\lambda_0$ and lifts $f_{ak,\lambda_a}\in\Gamma(U_{a,\lambda_a},\mathcal O)$. Set $\lambda_W:=u(\{\lambda_0\}\cup\{\lambda_a\}_a)$ using [def-nagata-directed-finite-upper-bound]; the separately proved property [lemma-nagata-directed-finite-upper-bound] gives $\lambda_a\leq\lambda_W$, so transport each lift to $f_{ak,\lambda_W}$ and define $W_{\lambda_W}:=\bigcup_{a,k}D(f_{ak,\lambda_W})\subseteq Y_{\lambda_W}$. This witness depends on the chosen finite affine cover, presentations, and lifts; [pqf-lem-limit-qc-open-descends], clause (2), makes any two choices agree at a later stage.
